item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately assigns an internal advisory and coordination role to an executive official; this is executive organization rather than a change in legal rights or status.","evidence":"is hereby designated as the National Continuity Coordinator"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Coordinator and committee are directed to coordinate policy development and implementation through an internal executive-branch forum.","evidence":"shall coordinate the development and implementation of continuity policy"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The provision internally organizes executive departments and agencies into continuity categories based on their governmental roles.","evidence":"each executive department and agency is assigned to a category"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The segment assigns coordination responsibilities and requires development and submission of an internal implementation plan for later presidential approval.","evidence":"will lead the development of a National Continuity Implementation Plan"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The segment mandates coordination and integration of governmental continuity policies and plans, which is internal administrative management.","evidence":"shall be appropriately coordinated with those of the legislative and judicial branches"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The segment prescribes executive continuity planning, operational-readiness requirements, coordination, and future presidential setting of readiness levels, without itself changing private legal rights or status.","evidence":"Continuity requirements for the Executive Office of the President (EOP) and executive departments and agencies shall include the following"},{"segment_id":"7","code":2,"rationale":"Among extensive planning and oversight duties, the segment mandates that the Secretary later make grant funding available, a specified legally consequential agency result.","evidence":"Make available continuity planning and exercise funding, in the form of grants as provided by law"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The segment directs agencies to provide internal government communications, execute continuity plans, appoint coordinators, budget, train, and support continuity requirements.","evidence":"Heads of executive departments and agencies shall execute their respective department or agency COOP plans"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The segment supplies an implementation constraint and consultation instruction concerning continuity and presidential succession.","evidence":"This directive shall be implemented in a manner that is consistent with"},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"Agency heads must provide internal operational support so relevant officials remain prepared to implement succession provisions.","evidence":"shall ensure that appropriate support is available"},{"segment_id":"11","code":1,"rationale":"The segment performs administrative housekeeping by revoking a prior continuity directive, incorporating annexes, and prescribing information-security handling; the codebook expressly treats such revocations as internal management.","evidence":"is hereby revoked"}]}
